other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes global transformations (such as imputation for tree models, clustering, and target encoding global statistics) on the entire training set outside the cross-validation loop. This leaks information from validation folds into training folds, artificially inflating the out-of-fold validation scores.

other_failure_modes.name: TypeError on Empty Categorical Columns
other_failure_modes.description: The agent attempts to concatenate text features using `.agg(' | '.join, axis=1)` on a DataFrame subset of categorical columns. If the dataset has no categorical columns (or all were successfully coerced to numeric), this operation is performed on an empty DataFrame, which raises a TypeError in pandas and crashes the script.

summary: The agent provides an extremely thorough and advanced solution, including a wide array of models, feature engineering, and ensembling. However, it suffers from data leakage across cross-validation folds by applying global transformations (like imputation and clustering) before the CV loop. Additionally, a fragile pandas aggregation on categorical columns causes a TypeError if no categorical columns are present, leading to script failure.
